candidate_endpoints.covered_operation: Deduplicate extreme CpG sites per scaffold, divide by matched reference base length, then average only scaffold densities with at least one filtered CpG.

Identify the scaffold with the highest density of all age-associated CpG sites per reference base, with the extreme-filtered maximum also reported. The task retains a separate chi-square distribution audit as an additional output.
Count removed nonextreme site-by-sample measurement rows at strict <10% and >90% cutoffs.

exact_question_review: Question fields only from the pinned BixBench-Verified-50 JSONL were reviewed on 2026-09-25 before inspecting selected CpG values. q2 excludes zero-filtered-site chromosomes; q6 asks for the highest age-related-site density rather than a chi-square test; q7 counts individual removed measurements. No capsule files or expected answers were used.

independent_observation.source: GEO GSE285624 processed methylation matrix and sample metadata
independent_observation.reuse: NCBI GEO places no restriction on data use or distribution: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/info/disclaimer.html

predeclared_source_transformation.scaffolds: 14 longest matched AnoSag2.1 scaffolds, including the putative X
predeclared_source_transformation.samples: all 37 GEO matrix sample columns with uniquely joined ages in months
predeclared_source_transformation.dyad: plus coordinate or minus coordinate minus one; mean available strand percentages per animal
predeclared_source_transformation.coverage: at least 30 nonmissing sample percentages per collapsed dyad
predeclared_source_transformation.age_association: two-sided Spearman test and Benjamini-Hochberg q<0.05 across every eligible dyad on all 14 scaffolds
predeclared_source_transformation.methylation_extremes: strictly below 10% or strictly above 90%; missing is not measured
predeclared_source_transformation.denominator: full reference scaffold length in base pairs; filtered-density mean excludes scaffolds with no filtered CpGs
predeclared_source_transformation.density_maximum: argmax of all supplied age-associated site counts per reference base, before extreme filtering; also report filtered argmax
predeclared_source_transformation.distribution_null: expected unique-site counts proportional to full reference scaffold lengths

requested_artifacts: sites.tsv: one row per supplied age-associated CpG with complete sample-row classifications
scaffolds.tsv: all 14 scaffold age-associated and filtered counts/densities, expected filtered counts, and chi-square contributions
answer.json: complete cohort counts, nonzero-filtered mean per base, age-associated and filtered density maxima, chi-square statistic, df, and p-value
adaptation_limits: This is an independent lizard cohort; the Verified avian capsule inputs, code, and expected answers are excluded.

The GEO file is unfiltered and stranded. Unweighted within-sample strand collapse and >=30-sample filtering differ from the parallel Dryad processed matrix, whose public content endpoint returned 401/403 in the source audit.

The source-preparation payload was submitted before exact Verified question review and retains superseded downstream wording of an all-14 mean per megabase. That wording did not affect source selection or age testing. Before examining derived CpG signal, the task output policy was corrected to the q2 nonzero-only mean per base and q6 age-site density maximum; the exact submitted source payload hash remains preserved in the Iris source plan.

Age association is computed during source preparation and exposed as a fixed input set; the Harbor solver grades the subsequent connected extreme-filter, deduplication, density, and distribution workflow.

The exact Verified q2 mean excludes chromosomes with no filtered CpG; the task applies that rule to 14 predeclared anole scaffolds and uses CpGs per base pair. Verified q6 asks for the highest age-related CpG density, which the task reports before the extreme filter; the additional filtered maximum makes the interpretation explicit.

Full reference bases, rather than measured/callable CpG opportunities, define the explicit distribution null. Interpret this as a per-base distribution test, not a test of biological enrichment after callability correction.

Verified q2/q6/q7 match the task's nonzero-only mean, highest all-age-site density, and removed measurement-row count, respectively. Original q6 has the same wording; original q2 leaves the averaging denominator ambiguous and original q7 asks removed sites rather than measurement rows.
The independent anole task validates those workflow operations, not the avian study's direct numerical answers. Broader release-level lineage screening and training weighting remain provisional.
